channel.title: Cadence
channel.description: Updates for Cadence, the calendar for work and life from Coursion.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
Cadence 1.2 brings a calmer menu bar panel, a redesigned iPhone app, and one Accounts list that answers Google and Outlook invitations.

A calmer menu bar
  • One calm glance at your day — The panel shows one header, a Now and Next card and one-line rows. Right-click it to keep it open.
  • Event pages and the day overview — Click a meeting or the date to slide its details into the panel. Esc, Back or a swipe returns.
  • A clock that rolls each minute — The menu bar shows the next meeting and the time, and only the changing digit rolls. Turn it off in Settings → Appearance.
  • Look ahead to any day — Pick a day in the week strip to see it first under its own header. Press Today or Esc to come back.
Cadence on iPhone, rebuilt
  • Today leads with what's next — Your next meeting comes first, with a live countdown and Join. Each event shows once, with replies in place.
  • Calendar and Inbox, redesigned — Calendar opens on a week strip that grows into the month. Inbox groups invitations by day, names each clash, and takes swipe replies.
  • A welcome that gets access right — Five short steps ask for calendar access and notifications, and Cadence no longer says "not granted" after you allow.
All your accounts in one list
  • Every account in one place — Settings → Accounts lists each account with its logo and status, with Set up replies, Reconnect and Remove.
  • More than one Google account — Add account always opens the full provider menu, so a second Google account, Outlook, iCloud or a CalDAV server is one step away.
Answer and edit in place
  • Reply to Google invitations — Accept, Maybe or Decline goes through your own Google account. You have ten seconds to Undo.
  • Answer in Outlook on the web — Outlook and Microsoft 365 invitations offer a button that opens the day in Outlook on the web.
  • Edit events (⌘E) — Change a meeting in the edit sheet, drag to move or resize it, or ⌥-drag to duplicate. Delete has Undo.
Life beside your work
  • Reminders in your day — Due reminders sit in the agenda, the panel and Today. Complete one with a click, and Undo it if you need to.
  • Birthdays, weather and countdowns — Each day shows its forecast and the birthdays from Contacts. Pin an event to count down to it.
Steadier every day
  • Holidays show once — The same holiday listed by two calendars now appears once, in every view.
  • The panel keeps its corners — Going back from an event or the day overview no longer cuts off the panel's rounded top and bottom.
  • Updates arrive on their own — Cadence from cadence.coursion.studio checks for a new version and offers to install it. Turn this off in Settings → General.
